name: HYDRA-UMC-DETECTION-HEF
build: Requires Hailo runtime/SDK on the real CM5 for the compilation toolchain itself (ONNX export, Dataflow Compiler, HEF packaging); the model registry (registry.py) needs neither.
notes: Established v0: real compiled-model registry - JSON schema validation (including a required, validated hailo_arch field), duplicate-version detection, latest-version lookup by name/task, and sha256 checksum verification against local files, exposed via 'registry validate'/'registry latest'. Real, combined safe-load gate (compatibility.py's safe_load()) checks Hailo-architecture compatibility before checksum integrity and never reports a model ready unless both real checks pass - exposed via the new 'registry load' subcommand. hef_path is now validated against path traversal (rejects an absolute path at parse time, and verify_checksum() confirms the resolved join stays inside models_dir) before any file is read or hashed. 37 tests. The ONNX/Dataflow-Compiler/HEF toolchain that would populate the registry still needs real Hailo hardware and is future work.
